integrity: The all-parameter proof is algebraic and separate from finite experiments. Tested direct trajectories over 827208 states and exact matrix ranks over 168 parameter pairs; these are corroboration, not exhaustive parameter coverage. No independent mathematical audit or publication claim.
scientific_limitations: Only undirected triangles and pentagons meeting at one hub, Boolean open-neighborhood XOR, and synchronous updates. No assertion for other petal lengths, fields, signed rules, or update conventions. A related 2026 graph-spectral paper was available as abstract/metadata but not full substantive text; unindexed priority risk persists.
title: Triangle–pentagon windmills: a complete parity-orbit and entrance-time census
